description: Five reads: OpenAI's research push, the alien-mind essay, DeepMind's APAC drive, GitHub's routing preview, and an agent checklist.
lead: Frontier labs are narrating how fast their own research is accelerating while shipping new agent machinery, and the applied world keeps absorbing it. This radar collects five primary-source reads worth a builder's time: internal numbers on coding-agent leverage, a warning about fading chain-of-thought monitorability, a sixteen-organization climate accelerator in Asia-Pacific, a multi-model routing preview for code assistants, and a practical checklist for reviewing the combined output of parallel coding agents. Each summary is in our own words; follow the links for the originals.
title: Link radar, September 8, 2026
